description: Sweeping, leaf-like abstract forms run diagonally across the canvas. The shapes are rendered in shades of white, pale yellow, blue, and brown. A large blue form on the lower right resembles a lake, while brown shapes appear as mountains looming above it. Billowing gray forms in the upper right corner of the composition could represent growing storm clouds.
